items.title: `StoreSome::assume()` outside any owner stands its keeper on the store for the store's life (B693's `register_with_owner` rule) - refuse it at compile time instead, as `on_cleanup` is: `assume` carries `context owner_scope`
items.kind: bug (std reactive store; owner contract; S)
items.status: OPEN - RULED 2026-11-03 by the owner (Q13: refusing is smarter); Order 56 std lane
items.discussion: the owner 2026-11-03 on store-assume-keeper.md Q1 / owner question 13: a keeper that lives for the store's life because nothing owned it is the defect the owner contract exists to prevent; `on_cleanup`'s precedent (reactive.vl ~:1377: 'there is no owner may not be a runtime no-op')
items.body:
Give `assume` the clause (`fun assume(self): Store

context owner_scope`) so a call outside an owner body is the existing context-coverage refusal at the call, with the requirement trace (E78) naming the chain; `when_live`/`when_remote_live` call it inside the body's owner and need nothing. The A142 S7 pin that calls `assume()` at the top of `main` moves inside an owner (`run_with_owner`). Estate census (std, website, corpus, kolt's 28 sites are all under `when_live`). Docs: store.md's `assume` paragraph; CHANGELOG `breaking` if any estate site moved. Pins: the refusal at a top-level `assume()`, the body form clean, the keeper census unchanged. Sizing S.

items.title: `std::image` follow-ups from the owner's rulings: `resized` answers `Result<Image, str>` past the pixel limit (as `decode` does; no panic), and JPEG encoding flattens transparency onto BLACK (the canvas / sharp / libvips / image-crate standard), not white
items.status: OPEN - RULED 2026-11-03 by the owner (Q22: make both Result; Q19: follow the most established standard = black); Order 56 std lane
items.discussion: the owner 2026-11-03 on image.md Q4 and the resize cap (owner questions 19 and 22); the established programmatic standard is black (a browser canvas's toDataURL('image/jpeg'), sharp/libvips, Rust's image crate all composite onto black; white is ImageMagick's/Photoshop's export matte)
items.body: (1) `resized`: drop the `[track_caller]` panic in image.vl - the seam already carries `Err` from both the wasm core and vilan-rt-image - and answer `Result<Image, str>`; the sentence unchanged (`a 100000 x 100000 result exceeds the 50,000,000-pixel limit`); docs std/image.md + CHANGELOG (the M185 entry's claim corrected in a new entry); the `m185_a_resize_past_the_pixel_limit_*` pins become `Err` pins on both backends. (2) JPEG: `flattened_on_white` -> onto black (`c * a / 255`), docs + the M185 CHANGELOG claim corrected, the blob rebuilt (build-image-wasm.sh; CI's byte check), the JPEG round-trip pins and the native differential re-pinned (bytes change). Both are breaking only for a program written against v0.54.0-pre (none). Sizing S.
